newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Feb metal exports up - paper.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Feb metal exports up - paper.

text.p: China exported 58,000 tonnes of rolled steel in January and February of 1997, up 28.0 percent from the same period a year ago, according to an edition of the Futures Herald seen in Beijing on Saturday.
Exports of rolled steel in February alone were 33,000 tonnes, the March 20 edition of the newspaper quoted customs figures.
Imports of rolled steel dropped a year-on-year 12.0 percent in the first two months to 1.62 million tonnes while imports in February alone were 730,000 tonnes, the newspaper said.

Exports of unwrought copper and copper materials totalled 28,678 tonnes in the first two months, a rise of 189.2 percent from the same period the year before, the newspaper said. Exports in February alone were 17,568 tonnes.
Imports of unwrought copper and copper materials hit 77,885 tonnes in the first two months, a rise of 28.2 percent from the same period a year ago, it said. February imports alone were 32,709 tonnes.
Exports of unwrought aluminium and aluminium materials were 35,030 tonnes in January-February, up 109.1 percent from the year-ago period. February's exports were 14,008 tonnes.
Imports of unwrought aluminium and alumina were 69,224 tonnes in January-February, a drop of 4.3 percent from the 1996 period. Imports in February alone were 31,378 tonnes.
